newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Bob Hawke joins China-hopeful Quantum.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Bob Hawke joins China-hopeful Quantum.

text.p: Gold miner and billionaire businessman Joe Gutnick said on Friday that former Australian Prime Minister Bob Hawke had been appointed to the board of his listed explorer Quantum Resources Ltd.

Gutnick said Hawke, who was Prime Minister from 1983 to 1991, would enhance the company's expansion into China and other parts of Asia. Hawke, described as a business consultant in the latest edition of Who's Who, would ensure that Quantum was speaking to the right people in China. "He will introduce us to the right quarters," Gutnick told Reuters.
"We think we have got a window of opportunity, that is why we are looking," Gutnick said.
"It is not only China, it is Indonesia, and the Philippines and the whole Pacific Rim area. I wouldn't be doing what I am doing with Mr Hawke if I didn't think there was."
Gutnick had previously said he hoped to expand Quantum's activities but had not referred to overseas opportunities.

Quantum forms part of the Gutnick-controlled group of locally-listed gold mining companies, led by Great Central Mines Ltd which has forecast 1996/97 output of more than 500,000 ounces. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
